001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.encoder;
002
003import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
004import java.util.function.Consumer;
005
006import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
007
008import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEncoder;
009import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEvent;
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter.LevelFormatter;
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter.ThrowableFormatter;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider;
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable;
015import io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.JsonBuffer;
016import io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.JsonBuffer.ExtendedFieldPrefix;
017import io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.JsonBuffer.JSONToken;
018
019/**
020 * A JSON encoder in
021 * <a href="https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/ecs-logging/java/current/index.html">Elastic
022 * Common Schema (ECS) logging format</a>.
023 * <p>
024 * Two shapes are supported, controlled by {@link #structured()}:
025 * <ul>
026 * <li><strong>Flattened (default)</strong>: field names are the flattened, dotted ECS
027 * field names (e.g. <code>"log.level"</code>) rather than nested JSON objects, matching
028 * how the reference <a href="https://github.com/elastic/ecs-logging-java">
029 * ecs-logging-java</a> implementation serializes them.</li>
030 * <li><strong>Structured</strong> ({@link EcsEncoderBuilder#structured(Boolean)
031 * structured=true}): fields are nested JSON objects (e.g.
032 * <code>"log":{"level":...}</code>), matching
033 * <a href="https://docs.spring.io/spring-boot/reference/features/logging.html">Spring
034 * Boot's ECS structured logging format</a>.</li>
035 * </ul>
036 * MDC / key values have no reserved ECS field in either shape, so - like both reference
037 * implementations - they are written as top-level fields using their own key name. This
038 * means a key value whose name collides with a reserved ECS field name (e.g.
039 * <code>message</code>) will overwrite it; that footgun exists in the reference
040 * implementations too.
041 */
042public final class EcsEncoder extends LogEncoder.AbstractEncoder<JsonBuffer> {
043
044        /**
045         * ECS encoder URI scheme.
046         */
047        public static final String ECS_SCHEME = "ecs";
048
049        /**
050         * The ECS schema version this encoder targets.
051         */
052        public static final String ECS_VERSION = "1.2.0";
053
054        private final @Nullable String serviceName;
055
056        private final @Nullable String serviceVersion;
057
058        private final @Nullable String serviceEnvironment;
059
060        private final @Nullable String serviceNodeName;
061
062        private final @Nullable String eventDataset;
063
064        private final boolean structured;
065
066        private final boolean prettyPrint;
067
068        private final int maxBufferSize;
069
070        private static final DateTimeFormatter timeFormatter = DateTimeFormatter.ISO_INSTANT;
071
072        EcsEncoder(@Nullable String serviceName, @Nullable String serviceVersion, @Nullable String serviceEnvironment,
073                        @Nullable String serviceNodeName, @Nullable String eventDataset, boolean structured, boolean prettyPrint,
074                        int maxBufferSize) {
075                super();
076                this.serviceName = serviceName;
077                this.serviceVersion = serviceVersion;
078                this.serviceEnvironment = serviceEnvironment;
079                this.serviceNodeName = serviceNodeName;
080                this.eventDataset = eventDataset;
081                this.structured = structured;
082                this.prettyPrint = prettyPrint;
083                this.maxBufferSize = maxBufferSize;
084        }
085
086        /**
087         * Whether fields are nested JSON objects (Spring Boot's ECS shape) instead of the
088         * default flattened, dotted field names (the reference ecs-logging-java shape).
089         * @return true if fields are nested.
090         */
091        public boolean structured() {
092                return this.structured;
093        }
094
095        /**
096         * Creates an ECS encoder using a lambda for easier registration. The builder will
097         * have properties loaded after the consumer has configured the builder.
098         * @param consumer lambda to configure builder.
099         * @return ECS encoder provider.
100         */
101        public static LogProvider<EcsEncoder> of(Consumer<EcsEncoderBuilder> consumer) {
102                return (s, c) -> {
103                        var b = new EcsEncoderBuilder(s);
104                        consumer.accept(b);
105                        return b.fromProperties(c.properties()).build();
106                };
107        }
108
109        /**
110         * Creates ECS Encoder.
111         * @param name property name prefix.
112         * @param serviceName <code>service.name</code> field, or null to omit.
113         * @param serviceVersion <code>service.version</code> field, or null to omit.
114         * @param serviceEnvironment <code>service.environment</code> field, or null to omit.
115         * @param serviceNodeName <code>service.node.name</code> field, or null to omit.
116         * @param eventDataset <code>event.dataset</code> field, or null to omit.
117         * @param structured <code>true</code> nests fields as JSON objects (Spring Boot's ECS
118         * shape) instead of flattened dotted field names, default is false.
119         * @param prettyPrint <code>true</code> will pretty print the JSON, default is false.
120         * @param maxBufferSize maximum buffer size - a soft ceiling checked between events,
121         * not a hard cap enforced on any single event (see
122         * {@link LogEncoder.Buffer#isOversized()}). A negative value (the default) disables
123         * this entirely.
124         * @return encoder.
125         */
126        @LogConfigurable(prefix = LogProperties.ENCODER_PREFIX)
127        static EcsEncoder of(@LogConfigurable.KeyParameter String name, @Nullable String serviceName,
128                        @Nullable String serviceVersion, @Nullable String serviceEnvironment, @Nullable String serviceNodeName,
129                        @Nullable String eventDataset, @Nullable Boolean structured, @Nullable Boolean prettyPrint,
130                        @Nullable Integer maxBufferSize) {
131                prettyPrint = prettyPrint == null ? false : prettyPrint;
132                structured = structured == null ? false : structured;
133                int _maxBufferSize = maxBufferSize == null ? -1 : maxBufferSize;
134                return new EcsEncoder(serviceName, serviceVersion, serviceEnvironment, serviceNodeName, eventDataset,
135                                structured, prettyPrint, _maxBufferSize);
136        }
137
138        @Override
139        protected JsonBuffer doBuffer(BufferHints hints) {
140                return new JsonBuffer(this.prettyPrint, ExtendedFieldPrefix.AT, maxBufferSize);
141        }
142
143        @Override
144        protected void doEncode(LogEvent event, JsonBuffer buffer) {
145                buffer.clear();
146                var formattedMessage = buffer.getFormattedMessageBuilder();
147                event.formattedMessage(formattedMessage);
148
149                int index = structured ? encodeStructured(event, buffer, formattedMessage)
150                                : encodeFlattened(event, buffer, formattedMessage);
151
152                if (index > 0 && prettyPrint) {
153                        buffer.writeLineFeed();
154                }
155                buffer.write(JSONToken.OBJECT_END);
156                buffer.writeLineFeed();
157        }
158
159        private int encodeFlattened(LogEvent event, JsonBuffer buffer, StringBuilder formattedMessage) {
160                var now = event.timestamp();
161                var t = event.throwableOrNull();
162
163                buffer.write(JSONToken.OBJECT_START);
164                int index = 0;
165                index = buffer.write("@timestamp", timeFormatter.format(now), index);
166                index = buffer.write("log.level", LevelFormatter.toString(event.level()), index);
167                index = buffer.write("message", formattedMessage.toString(), index);
168                index = buffer.write("ecs.version", ECS_VERSION, index);
169                index = buffer.write("service.name", serviceName, index);
170                index = buffer.write("service.version", serviceVersion, index);
171                index = buffer.write("service.environment", serviceEnvironment, index);
172                index = buffer.write("service.node.name", serviceNodeName, index);
173                index = buffer.write("event.dataset", eventDataset, index);
174                index = buffer.write("log.logger", event.loggerName(), index);
175                index = buffer.write("process.thread.name", event.threadName(), index);
176
177                if (t != null) {
178                        index = buffer.write("error.type", t.getClass().getName(), index);
179                        index = buffer.write("error.message", t.getMessage(), index);
180                        var stackTrace = new StringBuilder();
181                        ThrowableFormatter.appendThrowable(stackTrace, t);
182                        index = buffer.write("error.stack_trace", stackTrace.toString(), index);
183                }
184
185                index = writeKeyValues(event, buffer, index);
186                return index;
187        }
188
189        private int encodeStructured(LogEvent event, JsonBuffer buffer, StringBuilder formattedMessage) {
190                var now = event.timestamp();
191                var t = event.throwableOrNull();
192
193                buffer.write(JSONToken.OBJECT_START);
194                int index = 0;
195                index = buffer.write("@timestamp", timeFormatter.format(now), index);
196
197                int logIndex = buffer.writeObjectStart("log", index, 0);
198                logIndex = buffer.write("level", LevelFormatter.toString(event.level()), logIndex, 0);
199                buffer.write("logger", event.loggerName(), logIndex, 0);
200                buffer.writeObjectEnd();
201                index++;
202
203                index = buffer.write("message", formattedMessage.toString(), index);
204
205                int ecsIndex = buffer.writeObjectStart("ecs", index, 0);
206                buffer.write("version", ECS_VERSION, ecsIndex, 0);
207                buffer.writeObjectEnd();
208                index++;
209
210                boolean hasService = serviceName != null || serviceVersion != null || serviceEnvironment != null
211                                || serviceNodeName != null;
212                if (hasService) {
213                        int serviceIndex = buffer.writeObjectStart("service", index, 0);
214                        serviceIndex = buffer.write("name", serviceName, serviceIndex, 0);
215                        serviceIndex = buffer.write("version", serviceVersion, serviceIndex, 0);
216                        serviceIndex = buffer.write("environment", serviceEnvironment, serviceIndex, 0);
217                        if (serviceNodeName != null) {
218                                int nodeIndex = buffer.writeObjectStart("node", serviceIndex, 0);
219                                buffer.write("name", serviceNodeName, nodeIndex, 0);
220                                buffer.writeObjectEnd();
221                        }
222                        buffer.writeObjectEnd();
223                        index++;
224                }
225
226                if (eventDataset != null) {
227                        int eventIndex = buffer.writeObjectStart("event", index, 0);
228                        buffer.write("dataset", eventDataset, eventIndex, 0);
229                        buffer.writeObjectEnd();
230                        index++;
231                }
232
233                int processIndex = buffer.writeObjectStart("process", index, 0);
234                int threadIndex = buffer.writeObjectStart("thread", processIndex, 0);
235                buffer.write("name", event.threadName(), threadIndex, 0);
236                buffer.writeObjectEnd();
237                buffer.writeObjectEnd();
238                index++;
239
240                if (t != null) {
241                        int errorIndex = buffer.writeObjectStart("error", index, 0);
242                        errorIndex = buffer.write("type", t.getClass().getName(), errorIndex, 0);
243                        errorIndex = buffer.write("message", t.getMessage(), errorIndex, 0);
244                        var stackTrace = new StringBuilder();
245                        ThrowableFormatter.appendThrowable(stackTrace, t);
246                        buffer.write("stack_trace", stackTrace.toString(), errorIndex, 0);
247                        buffer.writeObjectEnd();
248                        index++;
249                }
250
251                index = writeKeyValues(event, buffer, index);
252                return index;
253        }
254
255        private static int writeKeyValues(LogEvent event, JsonBuffer buffer, int index) {
256                var kvs = event.keyValues();
257                return kvs.forEach((src, k, v, idx, buf) -> buf.write(k, v, idx), index, buffer);
258        }
259
260}
